episode_title: Should You Stop Paid Search for AI Optimization?

real_qa.q: What percentage of U.S. Google searches ended without a click in early 2026?
real_qa.r: 68% of U.S. Google searches ended without a click in early 2026, and this no-click era has only grown as 2026 rounds out. Additionally, AI overviews show up on more than 20% of searches, and when they do, clicks drop by nearly 60%.

real_qa.q: How much did the share of consumers using AI to find local businesses grow in one year?
real_qa.r: The share of consumers using AI to find a local business went from 6% to 45% in one year. AI is now the third most used way to find a local business behind Google and Facebook.
real_qa.requete: AI local business search growth 6% to 45%

real_qa.q: What are the three main signals that matter to AI for business recommendations?
real_qa.r: The three signals are: one, location—name, address, phone number accuracy; two, reputation—what people say about you online and reviews on your Google Business page; and three, content—when people ask specific questions, ChatGPT, Claude, and Google AI overviews pull information from business websites, so having helpful consumer information on your website is critical for being recommended.
real_qa.requete: AI business recommendations three signals location reputation content

real_qa.q: What percentage of adults use an AI chatbot to gather information?
real_qa.r: Only about 42% of adults use an AI chatbot to gather information, which means most people are not using it. Additionally, even those using it are not necessarily using it to get all their answers—they may use it for deep research, content creation, or other purposes.

real_qa.q: How much did Google's search ad revenue grow in Q2 2024?
real_qa.r: Search engine marketing (SEM) or search ad revenue grew by 17%, reaching $63.3 billion in quarter two of this year, demonstrating that Google's paid search business remains a strong and growing revenue driver.
real_qa.requete: Google search ad revenue Q2 2024 $63.3 billion

real_qa.q: What percentage of searchers prefer traditional search for big financial and health decisions?
real_qa.r: 57% prefer traditional search for topics like money and health topics, including credit unions, healthcare, and big purchases like cars. This shows that even among search users, AI is not yet the preferred method for high-stakes decisions.
real_qa.requete: traditional search preference health money decisions 57%

guest.bio_context: Crystal is a core member of Federated Digital Solutions' team who led the development and implementation of the AI Location Concierge service launched in 2026. She specializes in Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), helping businesses become AI-recommended across platforms like Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. She actively uses Claude for research and has hands-on expertise in directory management, reputation optimization, and AI-driven content strategies.
